name: 皮肤切换器-Skin Changer
author: Gurio
description: 切换角色、卡牌、怪物、先古场景和商人皮肤；多人游戏可按玩家同步角色皮肤、头像和局内外观参数，并在全员准备后按默认开启的选项安全缓存缺少的外观资源，关闭后其它玩家使用原皮且不下载。界面支持 15 种语言，无需重启。 Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, and merchant skins; multiplayer syncs each player's character skin, avatar, and live model/UI transforms and, after everyone is ready, safely caches missing cosmetic resources when the default-on option is enabled. When disabled, other players use original skins and nothing is downloaded. 15-language interface, no restart required.
